buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Eligibility criteria 1. The vehicle should be commercially registered in the name of Tenderer and should not sublet any part o f the contract. However, the Tenderer can have Lease Agreement with the owner of the vehicle/cab aggreg ator on non-judicial stamp paper for the tenure of the contract, which should be submitted along with the b id. The tenderer is required to submit the Vehicle registration details along with supporting documents of t he vehicle fulfilling the category, specifications etc, failing to submit the same along with the bid, the offer will be summarily rejected. 2. Availability of Office Of Service Provider: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Andhra Pradesh for better coordination and service. Documentary evidence to be uploaded along with the bid offer.[GST certificate/Firm registration certificates should be considered for local office] 3. Bidder financial standing and non-banning: The bidder must not have suffered bankruptcy/insolvency, u nder liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings during the last 5 years. The bidder should not ha ve been banned or debarred by any Central/ State Government/ agency of Central/ State Government/ Pub lic Sector Undertaking/ Regulatory Authority of India at the time of submission of this bid. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Submission of undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents - The bidders shall submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents submitted / uploaded along with the tender. T his shall be mandatory for all the bidders. In case of failure of the bidder to submit the undertaking, their of fer shall be summarily rejected [Proforma as per Annexure-IV of Buyer uploaded ATC document] 5. The bidders shall submit an “undertaking about Engagement of retired/existing railway employee” in th e format provided in Annexure-D1 and “Declaration” in the format provided in Annexure-D2 of Buyer uploa ded ATC document along with the bid offer. 6. The bidder shall give full details of the constitution of the Firm/Company/Society etc. and shall also sub mit following documents (as applicable), in addition to documents mentioned above: (a) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarized copy of the affidavit. (b) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of

(i) registered/notarized Partnership Deed and (ii) Power of Attorney duly authorizing one or more of the par tners of the firm or any other person(s), authorized by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to s ubmit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements, sign Measurement Books, receive paym ent, make correspondences, compromise/settle/ relinquish any claim (s) preferred by the firm, sign 'No Claim certificate', refer all or any dispute to arbitration and to take similar action in respect of all Bids/cont racts OR said Bid/contract. (c) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Venture (JV) not permitted /not allowed in reference to para 2.4.1 of GCC of Ser vices. (d) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall submit (i) the copies of MOA (Memor andum of Association) and AOA (Articles of Association) of the Company; and (ii) Power of Attorney duly re gistered/notarized by the company (backed by the resolution of Board of Directors) in favour of the individ ual, signing the Bid on behalf of the Company. (e) Society: The bidder shall submit (i) Self- attested copy of the certificate of Registration, (ii) Deed of Formation and (iii) Power of Attorney in favour of the tender signatory. 7. The bidder should have satisfactorily completed* in the last three previous financial years and the curre nt financial year upto the date of opening of the bid, against one similar single service contract** for a mini mum of 35% of advertised value of the bid. *Completed service contract includes on-going service contract subject to payment of bills amounting to a t least 35% of the advertised value of the bid. **Similar service contract means “Any kind of service contract pertains to passenger vehicle hiring”. Work experience certificates from private individuals shall not be accepted. Certificate from public listed c ompany/private company/Trusts having annual turnover of Rs.500 crores and above subject to the same b eing issued from their Head Office by a person of the company duly enclosing his authorization by the Man agement for issuing such credentials will be considered. 8. T1-Financial Turnover: The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not less than 1.5 times th e advertised bid value during the last three previous financial years and in the current financial year up to the date of opening of the bid. The audited balance sheet reflecting financial turnover certified by chartere d accountant with his/her stamp, signature and membership number for the completed financial years shal l be considered. For the current financial year, a Provisional Balance Sheet issued by a Chartered Accountant clearly indicat ing contractual receipts and supported by Income Tax Form-26AS shall be considered [Similar Pro forma a s per Annexure-II of Buyer uploaded ATC document]. NOTE: (i) Financial Year shall normally be reckoned as 1st April to 31st March of the Next Year. However, for Turn over Criteria, the Financial Year as applicable to the Company/ Tenderer is to be considered, if it differs fro m the above. (ii)Current Financial Year is reckoned as the incomplete Financial Year in which the date of tender submissi on falls.

(iii)Chartered Accountant statements duly indicating yearly receipts will not be considered until and unless supported by Audited Balance Sheets or Provisional Balance Sheets with 26AS statement of Income Tax D epartment. (iv)If the tender is not accompanied by the certificate(s) in support of financial eligibility as above, the tend er shall be rejected. No post-tender correspondence will be entertained. 9. T2- Liquidity: The bidder should have access to or has available liquid assets, lines of credit and other fi nancial means to meet cash flow that is valued at 5% of the estimated bid value net of applicant's commit ments for other contracts. The audited balance sheet and/or banking reference certified by a chartered ac countant with his/her stamp, signature and membership number shall be submitted by the bidder along wi th the bid. Banking reference should contain in clear terms the amount that the bank will be in a position to lend for t his work to the applicant/member of the Joint Venture/Consortium. In case the Net Current Assets (as seen from the Balance Sheets) are negative, only the Banking references will be considered. Otherwise the aggr egate of the Net Current Assets and submitted Banking references will be considered for working out the Li quidity. The banking reference should be from a Scheduled Bank in India and it should not be more than 3 months old as on date of submission of bids. [Similar Proforma as per Annexure-III of Buyer uploaded ATC docume nt]. 10. Each bidder shall be assigned a score for their technical bid as mentioned in Least Cost Least Cost Met hod Based Evaluation (LCS) . The score of technical bids should be more than or equal to minimum qualifying marks. The Minimum qualifying marks for this bid is 60 marks. The marking scheme/system of a ssigning score shall be as per uploaded documents in hyperlink of Least Cost Method Based Evaluation (L CS) of bid document This Bid is based on Least Cost Method Based Evaluation (LCS). The technical qualification parameters are:- Parameter Name Max Min Evaluation Seller Documen t Marks Marks Document Required Previous Work Done 20 0 Enclosed in Anne Yes xures Turnover 35 0 Enclosed in Anne Yes xures

Number of years in operatio 20 0 Enclosed in Anne Yes ns xures Total Minimum Passing Technical Marks: 45 B. SPECIAL CONDITIONS TO BE INCLUDED IN THE VEHICLE CONTRACT 1. Contract Period: 02 years. 2. Kilometer usage limit: 2000 KMs per month (24,000 KMs per annum). 3. Extra KMs & Hrs: Payment will be made on a monthly basis as per accepted monthly rate irrespective of actual KM run in that month. Payment will be made on a monthly basis (30 days) and the date of deploym ent of each vehicle for each department will be considered as the Day 1 of the month and payment will be made accordingly. 4. Variation in km is normally not permitted. In case of any excess usage beyond the cumulative KMs, the c oncerned officer shall furnish proper justification, and suitable compensation will be paid to the contractor strictly in accordance with GeM conditions, with the approval of concerned PHOD/CHOD. In respect of PHO Ds/CHODs, approval of GM shall be mandatory. 5. Normal duty hours are 12 hrs a day. Timing may vary as per requirement of the officer. However, as per working of Railways being 24*7, drivers may be called anytime in an emergency situation. The contractor must ensure availability of drivers at emergent times. Drivers should have live mobile phone connection so that they are contactable whenever required. 6. In case, on any day, the vehicle was utilized for more than 12 hours on exceptional/ emergency require ment, relaxation to that extent may be provided in subsequent days to the Contractor/firm. 7. Imposition of penalties is as per GeM SLA. 8. Payment of bill will be processed by the vehicle user department on submission of proper invoice along with log sheet and passed by Associate Accounts Officer. 9. PVC is not applicable. 10. Payment of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) and Performance Guarantee (PG) will be governed by GCC f or Services, 2018 and instructions issued by Railway Board from time to time. 11. The vehicle proposed to be offered on hire should be in good condition and not more than 3 years old, on the date of opening of tender. 12. It is desirable that drivers should wear proper neat and clean formal uniforms (white) with shoes. 13. A Log Book for each vehicle shall be maintained by the Contractor for the hired vehicles. It is the respo nsibility of the official using the vehicle to keep the log book up to date. 14. GCC-2018 for services with upto date correction slips must be followed. NOTE: LCS will be evaluated as per enclosed Annexures
